entries.title: Psalms 12:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David, destitute of human comfort, craves help of God. 3 He comforts himself with God's promises, and his judgments on the wicked.

(Title.) Sheminith. or, The eighth. 6:1; *title 1Ch 15:21 Help. or, Save. 3:7; 6:4; 54:1; Mt 8:25; 14:30 godly. Ge 6:12; Isa 1:9,21,22; 57:1; 63:5; Jer 5:1; Mic 7:1,2; Mt 24:12 faithful. Pr 20:6; Isa 59:4,13-15

entries.title: Psalms 12:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: With. Jer 18:18; Jas 3:5,6 our own. Heb. with us. who. Ge 3:5; Ex 5:2; Job 21:14,15; Jer 2:31; Da 3:15; 2Th 2:4

entries.title: Psalms 12:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: thou shalt. 16:1; 37:28,40; 121:8; 145:20; De 33:3; 1Sa 2:9; Isa 27:3; 1Pe 1:5 Jude 1:1 them, etc. Heb. him, i.e. every one of them. this. 10:18; Mt 3:7

entries.title: Psalms 12:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: wicked. Pr 29:12; Ho 5:11; Mic 6:16 when. Jud 9:18-57; 1Sa 18:17,18; Es 3:6-15; Isa 32:4-6; Mr 14:63-65 men. Heb. of the sons of men. Job 30:8; Da 11:21
